metadataRaw.title: How to Fix Suboccipital Pain in 30 SECONDS (Base of Skull Pain Relief)
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows easy exercises that can offer instant suboccipital muscle pain relief, even in as little as 30 seconds.

If you're unfamiliar with he suboccipital muscles, they are a group of muscles that are located under the base of the skull.

When they become strained and inflamed, they can cause pain in the upper neck that can radiate to the back and side of the head. Also, they are a main muscle that causes tension headaches.

To make getting relief easy, the exercises will focus on lengthening and strengthening the suboccipital muscles for both quick and long-lasting relief.
